facts.text: Nebraska Promise covers undergraduate tuition at the University of Nebraska-Lincoln for qualifying in-state students with a family income of $65,000 or less or who are Pell Grant-eligible.

sources.title: Nebraska Promise | Undergraduate Office of Admissions | University of Nebraska–Lincoln
sources.quote: With Nebraska Promise, students who meet academic qualifications and have a family income of $65,000 or less (Adjusted Gross Income/AGI) or are Pell Grant-eligible can attend tuition-free.
